sections.theory:
Biomechanical principles for increasing ability in different games

Netball

Increase in performance in netball through biomechanical principles:

Netball is played in a court of rectangular shape. Its length is 30.50 metres and breadth 15.25 metres. In it the player scores by putting the ball into a ring 10 feet high from the ground. For it the following skills are necessary.

Catching the ball

Passing

Passing the ball through the ring

Catching the ball

To catch a pass given by one’s fellow player it is necessary to take care of three things.

Speed of the ball

To gain possession of the ball it is necessary that the speed of the ball be estimated. The faster the ball comes towards you, the more the collision will arise. Here the third law of motion applies, i.e. the reaction of an action is equal but in the opposite direction. Therefore as soon as the ball touches the player’s hands, he should move the arms backwards while closing the hands; otherwise the fast ball, striking the hands, will go away in the opposite direction with the same speed.

Height of the ball

If the ball is coming high towards the player, then the player will have to jump and catch the ball. In this case it is necessary to maintain balance.
